Tank.coreItems: Dominance Ice, Antique Cuirass, Athena's Shield
Tank.tips: Frontline initiate, jangan masuk tanpa vision. Pick-off → force objective.

Fighter.coreItems: War Axe, Queen's Wings, Brute Force Breastplate
Fighter.tips: Trade lewat skill sustain, jangan greedy. Level 4 = powerspike utama.

Assassin.coreItems: Berserker's Fury, Endless Battle, Bloodlust Axe
Assassin.tips: Jungle clear → gank Gold/Mid. Focus pick-off MM musuh sebelum teamfight.

Mage.coreItems: Lightning Truncheon, Genius Wand, Holy Crystal
Mage.tips: Mid clear cepat → rotate side lane. Blue buff = spam skill tanpa batas.

Marksman.coreItems: Berserker's Fury, Corrosion Scythe, Malefic Roar
Marksman.tips: Gold lane: farm aman sampai 2 item. Teamfight = belakang Tank, DPS konstan.

Support.tips: Roam: temani core, beri vision river. Jangan last hit minion.
